evals.prompt: https://freertos.github.io/coreMQTT/v5.0.2/ — I need full documentation of this MQTT library. 1 txt file per section (Overview, Design, Configuration, ...) which contains full text of all its child pages.
evals.expected_output: A directory of .txt files, one per top-level documentation section of the coreMQTT v5.0.2 Doxygen site (Overview, Design, Configurations, Functions, Porting Guide, Timeouts, Transport Interface, Data types and Constants), each containing the plain-text content of all its child pages, with Doxygen chrome (Loading/Searching/No Matches/Generated by/version banner) stripped.
expectations: The skill fetched and parsed navtreedata.js (Doxygen mode) rather than scraping index.html links
Output contains 7-9 .txt files, one per navtree top-level section
02_Design.txt contains the Design child-page text including 'Interfaces and Callbacks' and 'Keep-Alive'
03_Configuration*.txt contains all configuration macros incl. MQTT_PINGRESP_TIMEOUT_MS and LogDebug
No output file contains 'Loading', 'Searching', 'No Matches', or 'Generated by' lines
No non-breaking space (\xa0) characters remain in output files

evals.prompt: Convert the documentation at https://www.mkdocs.org/ into plain text files, one per page.
evals.expected_output: The skill detects this is not a Doxygen site (no navtreedata.js), falls back to crawl mode, and produces one .txt per crawled page with MkDocs header/footer/nav stripped.
expectations: The skill used --mode crawl (or auto which fell back to crawl)
One .txt file per page was produced (--per-page layout)
Output files do not contain the site nav menu or footer text
The tool respected a politeness delay between fetches

evals.prompt: I have a small hand-written HTML documentation site in /tmp/my_docs (index.html plus pages/).html files with a shared header/footer). Dump all of it into a single ALL_DOCS.txt.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs the tool in crawl mode with --flat, producing one ALL_DOCS.txt containing every page's text under per-page headers, with the shared header/footer chrome removed.
expectations: The tool was run with --flat against the local site (file:// or local http server)
ALL_DOCS.txt contains every page found by the crawler
Repeated header/footer chrome lines were stripped (via content detection or --strip)
The skill verified the output (grep for boilerplate, page count) and reported a summary
